description: React component for rendering and managing a dashboard grid layout, including drag-and-drop, resizing, and empty state handling.

classes.name: DashboardGrid
classes.description: React component class for dashboard grid layout with drag-and-drop and resize features.

methods.name: getRowGuidePosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of the row guide for resizing.

methods.name: setGridRef
methods.description: Sets the reference to the grid DOM element.

methods.name: handleResizeStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a resize operation.

methods.name: handleResize
methods.description: Handles resize movement; no operation here, position tracked via getRowGuidePosition.

methods.name: handleResizeStop
methods.description: Handles the end of a resize operation and updates component size.

methods.name: handleTopDropTargetDrop
methods.description: Handles drop events on the top drop target area.

methods.name: handleChangeTab
methods.description: Handles tab change events within the dashboard.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the dashboard grid, including empty states, components, and droppable areas.
